thesis_statement: Law of the Minimum (Liebig's Law) - Plant growth is dictated not by total resources available, but by the scarcest resource (limiting factor)
Artificial Selection (Domestication) - Human-directed selective breeding alters the phenotypic traits of populations over generations
Nitrogen Cycle - Nitrogen is converted into multiple chemical forms as it circulates among atmospheric, terrestrial, and marine ecosystems
